Bug_Title: BIT: Bitwise OR of signed byte value (BIT_IOR_OF_SIGNED_BYTE)
Bug_Explanation: The code performs a bitwise OR on a signed byte value without masking it to ensure no sign extension occurs. This results in unintended sign extension when the byte value is negative (e.g., 0xFF), causing incorrect results.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case calls the showBug method with a byte array containing a negative byte value 0xFF. This triggers the bug when the method performs a bitwise OR without masking, causing unintended sign extension and resulting in the wrong integer value.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the test passed successfully (OK), which means the actual result matched the expected result. This suggests that the bug was not triggered during the test execution.
